purpose: Locate the user's existing ai-prose-baselines-private/ folder before a fresh SETEC instance creates an empty duplicate. Searches common locations (repo sibling, ~/Documents, Obsidian / Dropbox / Google Drive / OneDrive / iCloud roots, home), summarizes each candidate (manifest entries, impostor personas, last modified), recommends one, and prints the SETEC_BASELINES_DIR export line. Read-only.
use_when: first-run setup, or a new machine or git worktree, before any script writes baselines
SETEC appears to be writing into an empty baselines folder instead of your synced one
